name: E-commerce
looksLike: a website where I can buy things
a shop with prices baskets and checkout
definition: A website that lets people browse products, compare options, add items to a cart, and complete a purchase, with clear information about delivery and returns.
goal: Help shoppers find suitable products and buy with confidence.

sections.name: Shop navigation
sections.purpose: Help shoppers browse and narrow the product range.

sections.name: Product collection
sections.purpose: Show useful images, prices, and availability.

sections.name: Cart and checkout
sections.purpose: Let shoppers review quantities and the complete cost before payment.

sections.name: Support and policies
sections.purpose: Explain returns, delivery, and how to contact support.

prompts.short: Build an online store with product browsing, clear prices, a cart, and accessible checkout.
prompts.detailed: Build a e-commerce website for people researching and buying products. Help shoppers find suitable products and buy with confidence. Include shop navigation, product collection, product details, cart and checkout, support and policies. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Transparent total costs before payment.
